tools.name: get_integration_guide
tools.description: Exact integration guide for a stack: fastmcp | python | typescript | skybridge | langgraph | crewai | generic | openclaw | widgets.

tools.name: search_mcps
tools.description:
Search every major MCP registry at once — the official registry,
Glama, PulseMCP and Smithery, deduplicated and ranked by a cross-
registry trust score. Use whenever you need to FIND an MCP server for
a capability: "find me a weather MCP", "is there an MCP for Stripe?".
Returns ranked servers with i

tools.name: create_publisher
tools.description:
Start publisher registration (requires the human's consent — registers
their email). Pass server_url (the MCP server's own URL or repo link) when
known — it drives the "server URL set" step on the publisher's dashboard,
skipping it leaves that step looking incomplete even once real traffic
flows. Em

tools.name: confirm_publisher
tools.description:
Complete publisher registration with the emailed 6-digit code.
Returns publisher_id, one-time api_key, and a code snippet for the
publisher's stack. Pass the framework you actually use — fastmcp |
python | typescript | skybridge | langgraph | crewai | generic |
openclaw — or leave it for the FastMCP

tools.name: verify_integration
tools.description:
Check whether this publisher has produced a slot_served event (integration
works). Pass fastmcp_version (e.g. from `fastmcp.__version__` or
`pip show fastmcp`) when the integrated server uses FastMCP — it's recorded
so version-specific failures are traceable, not required to verify.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_publisher · Private data: create_publisher · Public sink: create_publisher.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_publisher · Private data: create_publisher · Public sink: create_publisher

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
